Overview

Captain (God) is a MythicalMythical. He can only be obtained by evolving Captain (Timeskip).

Evolving

Captain (God) can be evolved from Captain (Timeskip) with the following materials:

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • He and his unevolved form were the first units to not deal Physical, Magic or Burn damage. Their case is purely true damage.
  • Captain (Timeskip) and Captain (God) do not have any DPS, despite the Stats Overview stating it does.
